title: The Reflected Face: How the Call Descends and the Answer Rises
description: From the simple observation that a man bending over water sees his face cast downward with the head reversed, the teaching unfolds the cosmic mystery of correspondence: this inverted reflection is the sign of the Call sent from above into the depths, and the Answer rising back to the First Man as the man straightens. Stars, zodia, trees, cattle, men all hang from their celestial originals; the shadow on the earth is the trace of the body raised from the Deep.
